Metadata.Title: Polish bro's MGS series 7
Metadata.Description: Greetings everyone, Polish bro here.The fall of Hollow Circle's leadership in New York was a major success. However, ICA has confirmed that several key members escaped before the operation concluded. Their trail leads to Sapienza, where they are attempting to recover assets, destroy evidence, and rebuild the organization.Eliminate all remaining members.A final note, 47. Andrea Penca may possess valuable intelligence. Keep his body hidden if possible.figure it out. Good hunting, MFs.
